+"""Standalone helper to call a callback with an optional single argument.
+
+Kept free of pytest imports so it can be used without the collection machinery.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+import inspect
+from typing import Any
+
+
+def call_with_optional_result(func: Callable[..., Any], arg: object) -> Any:
+    """Call the given function with the given argument if func accepts one argument, otherwise
+    calls func without arguments, and return the result of the call."""
+    arg_count = func.__code__.co_argcount
+    if inspect.ismethod(func):
+        arg_count -= 1
+    if arg_count:
+        return func(arg)
+    else:
+        return func()
diff --git a/testing/test_standalone_return_optional_call.py b/testing/test_standalone_return_optional_call.py

--- /dev/null
+++ b/testing/test_standalone_return_optional_call.py
@@ -0,0 +1,100 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import ModuleType
+
+import pytest
+
+
+def _load_module() -> ModuleType:
+    path = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "src" / "standalone_return_optional_call.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+        "standalone_return_optional_call", path
+    )
+    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+call_with_optional_result = _load_module().call_with_optional_result
+
+
+def test_no_argument_function_returns_result() -> None:
+    assert call_with_optional_result(lambda: 42, "ignored") == 42
+
+
+def test_one_argument_function_receives_arg_and_returns_result() -> None:
+    assert call_with_optional_result(lambda x: x * 2, 21) == 42
+
+
+def test_none_result_is_returned() -> None:
+    calls: list[object] = []
+
+    def func(value: object) -> None:
+        calls.append(value)
+
+    assert call_with_optional_result(func, "a") is None
+    assert calls == ["a"]
+
+
+def test_bound_methods_adjust_for_self() -> None:
+    class Obj:
+        def no_arg(self) -> str:
+            return "no-arg"
+
+        def one_arg(self, value: object) -> object:
+            return ("one-arg", value)
+
+    obj = Obj()
+    assert call_with_optional_result(obj.no_arg, "x") == "no-arg"
+    assert call_with_optional_result(obj.one_arg, "x") == ("one-arg", "x")
+
+
+def test_classmethod_is_treated_as_bound() -> None:
+    class Obj:
+        @classmethod
+        def no_arg(cls) -> type:
+            return cls
+
+    assert call_with_optional_result(Obj.no_arg, "x") is Obj
+
+
+def test_only_positional_parameters_are_counted() -> None:
+    def kwonly(*, value: int = 1) -> int:
+        return value
+
+    def varargs(*args: object) -> tuple[object, ...]:
+        return args
+
+    assert call_with_optional_result(kwonly, 5) == 1
+    assert call_with_optional_result(varargs, 5) == ()
+
+
+def test_function_with_default_argument_receives_arg() -> None:
+    def func(value: object = "default") -> object:
+        return value
+
+    assert call_with_optional_result(func, "given") == "given"
+
+
+def test_exceptions_propagate() -> None:
+    def func(value: object) -> None:
+        raise ValueError(value)
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="boom"):
+        call_with_optional_result(func, "boom")
+
+
+def test_callable_without_code_raises_attribute_error() -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
+        call_with_optional_result(len, "abc")
+
+
+def test_does_not_import_pytest_python_module() -> None:
+    source = (
+        Path(__file__).parent.parent / "src" / "standalone_return_optional_call.py"
+    ).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert "_pytest" not in source
+    assert "_call_with_optional_argument" not in source
notes:
Added a pytest-free copy of _call_with_optional_argument (co_argcount, inspect.ismethod adjustment, 0/1-arg dispatch) that returns the call result; tests load it by file path and cover dispatch, bound/class methods, kw-only/varargs, exception propagation and the AttributeError for callables without __code__.
